description: Header file defining the Context11 class, which provides D3D11-specific functionality for an OpenGL context within the ANGLE project. It includes method declarations for resource creation, drawing, state management, and debugging.

classes.name: Context11
classes.description: A class providing D3D11-specific implementation of an OpenGL context, including resource creation, drawing, and debugging functionalities.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the context is destroyed.

methods.name: createShader
methods.description: Creates a shader object with given shader state.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Creates a program object with given program state.

methods.name: drawArraysInstanced
methods.description: Draws instanced primitives using array data.

methods.name: drawArraysInstancedBaseInstance
methods.description: Draws instanced primitives with a base instance.

methods.name: drawElements
methods.description: Draws primitives using element array data.

methods.name: drawElementsBaseVertex
methods.description: Draws elements with a base vertex.

methods.name: drawElementsInstancedBaseVertex
methods.description: Draws instanced elements with a base vertex.

methods.name: drawElementsInstancedBaseVertexBaseInstance
methods.description: Draws instanced elements with base vertex and base instance.

methods.name: drawRangeElementsBaseVertex
methods.description: Draws a range of elements with a base vertex.

methods.name: pushDebugGroup
methods.description: Pushes a debug group with source and ID.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes the context state with dirty bits.

methods.name: memoryBarrierByRegion
methods.description: Sets a memory barrier by region.

methods.name: triggerDrawCallProgramRecompilation
methods.description: Triggers recompilation of draw call programs.

methods.name: triggerDispatchCallProgramRecompilation
methods.description: Triggers recompilation of dispatch call programs.
